description.value: Malone's Taphouse is a craft beer bar and full-service pub in the heart of downtown Vancouver, established in 1998 and a recognized neighbourhood institution for over two decades. The venue spotlights BC craft breweries through a rotating tap program called the Brewery Showdown, alongside an extensive food menu with pub classics and elevated dishes. Regular live music, trivia nights, and sports screenings make it a lively mid-ride or end-of-day stop for cyclists exploring the downtown core.
